title: K8s Secrets → AWS Secrets Manager Migration
description: Migrate Kubernetes Secrets to AWS Secrets Manager and update workloads to use the AWS Secrets Manager CSI driver or Parameter Store.

steps.action: Export K8s secrets: kubectl get secret -A -o json | jq '[.items[] | select(.type=="Opaque")]' > k8s-secrets.json (redact before storing)
steps.verify: JSON file lists all Opaque secrets with key names (values base64-encoded)

steps.action: Create corresponding secrets in AWS Secrets Manager: aws secretsmanager create-secret for each K8s secret, using JSON key-value format
steps.verify: aws secretsmanager list-secrets shows all migrated secrets; aws secretsmanager get-secret-value succeeds

steps.action: Install AWS Secrets Store CSI driver on EKS cluster: helm install secrets-store-csi-driver with ASCP provider
steps.verify: kubectl get pods -n kube-system | grep secrets-store shows Running pods

steps.action: Create SecretProviderClass objects mapping Secrets Manager paths to volume mount paths in pods
steps.verify: kubectl describe secretproviderclass shows correct objectName references

steps.action: Update Deployment/StatefulSet manifests to mount SecretProviderClass volumes instead of K8s Secret volumes; rolling redeploy
steps.verify: All pods Running; app reads secrets from /mnt/secrets-store; K8s Opaque secrets no longer referenced
steps.rollback: Revert deployment manifests to K8s Secret volumeMounts
